description: Defines the CKEDITOR.event class, a base class for event handling, including methods for registering, firing, and managing event listeners.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.event
classes.description: Base class providing event handling features, including methods for adding, firing, and removing event listeners.

classes.name: eventEntry
classes.description: Internal class representing an individual event's listener list and name.

methods.name: implementOn
methods.description: Implements event handling features onto a target object.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a listener function for a specific event.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event, calling all registered listeners with provided data.

methods.name: fireOnce
methods.description: Fires an event and then removes all listeners for that event.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a specific listener from an event.

methods.name: hasListeners
methods.description: Checks if any listeners are registered for a specific event.
